shared_elements: horizontal band or register of pattern
justification: The strongest overlap is that both surfaces combine schematic profile animals with circular/spiral and repeated geometric motifs arranged in registers or bounded zones. The major difference is that A is a dispersed set of pictographic animals and signs on a figure-like pillar surface, while B is organized around a framed composition with dense interlace borders and a prominent central object/scene, so the iconographic relationships are largely different.
